criteria_results.name: DPR clamp [1,2]
criteria_results.evidence: No evidence of device pixel ratio clamping in the code. The shader uniforms use device size but don't clamp DPR.
criteria_results.fix_hint: Add DPR clamping when setting uResolution: uniforms.uResolution.value.set(size.width * window.devicePixelRatio, size.height * window.devicePixelRatio); and clamp devicePixelRatio between 1 and 2.

criteria_results.name: prefers-reduced-motion
criteria_results.evidence: The code checks for reduced motion preference with window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') and skips animation updates when reducedMotion is true.

criteria_results.name: One dominant idea
criteria_results.evidence: The entire hero section is focused on the aurora borealis phenomenon with consistent visual language and supporting elements.

criteria_results.name: Palette <= 3 colors
criteria_results.evidence: The color palette is limited to green aurora (#00ff9d), magenta (#ff00aa), cyan, and deep blue night background. The implementation uses these consistently throughout.

criteria_results.name: Cinematic timing (1.2s+, power3.out)
criteria_results.evidence: The main headline animation uses duration: 3 with ease: 'power3.out', meeting the cinematic timing requirement.

criteria_results.name: WebGL fallback
criteria_results.evidence: The code includes a try/catch block for WebGL availability detection and state management for webglAvailable.

criteria_results.name: WCAG AA contrast 4.5:1
criteria_results.evidence: The text overlay on the aurora background may not meet 4.5:1 contrast ratio. The white text with rgba(255,255,255,0.7) on a dark gradient background needs verification.
criteria_results.fix_hint: Increase text opacity or add a subtle background overlay to ensure text meets WCAG AA contrast requirements. Use a contrast checker tool to verify ratios.

criteria_results.name: Keyboard nav (focus-visible)
criteria_results.evidence: No focus-visible styles or focus indicators are implemented for keyboard navigation. The CTA button and other interactive elements lack visible focus states.
criteria_results.fix_hint: Add CSS for :focus-visible with distinctive styling (e.g., outline or glow effect) to indicate keyboard focus. Implement this on all interactive elements.

criteria_results.name: Pause render when offscreen (IntersectionObserver)
criteria_results.evidence: No IntersectionObserver implementation is present to pause rendering when the hero section is offscreen.
criteria_results.fix_hint: Implement IntersectionObserver to detect when the hero section is in view. When not visible, pause animation frames and time updates in the shader.

criteria_results.name: Lazy-load/Suspense
criteria_results.evidence: The AuroraBorealis component is rendered immediately without lazy loading or Suspense boundaries.
criteria_results.fix_hint: Wrap the AuroraBorealis component in React.lazy and Suspense with a fallback. Consider using Next.js dynamic imports for code splitting.

criteria_results.name: Contrast 4.5:1 solar legibility
criteria_results.evidence: Similar to C15, the text overlay may not meet solar legibility standards for readability in various lighting conditions.
criteria_results.fix_hint: Increase text contrast and potentially add a semi-transparent background overlay behind text to ensure legibility in all viewing conditions.

criteria_results.name: Keyboard nav in 3D scene
criteria_results.evidence: No keyboard navigation support is implemented for the 3D aurora scene. Users cannot navigate or interact using only keyboard.
criteria_results.fix_hint: Implement keyboard controls for the 3D scene, such as arrow keys for navigation, Tab for element focus, and Enter for interaction.

criteria_results.name: Every element justifies existence
criteria_results.evidence: All elements serve a clear purpose: the aurora visualization, text content, navigation, and visual indicators all contribute to the hero experience.

criteria_results.name: One CTA per section
criteria_results.evidence: The hero section contains only one primary CTA button ('Witness the Phenomenon') with a clear destination.

criteria_results.name: TSL or WebGPU readiness
criteria_results.evidence: The implementation uses traditional WebGL shaders without any indication of TSL (Transform Shading Language) or WebGPU readiness.
criteria_results.fix_hint: Consider implementing a WebGPU detection and fallback system. For TSL, ensure shaders are written in a way that could be adapted to future shading standards.

strengths: Strong visual focus with a single dominant idea
